notes.title: Dev Diary #9
notes.content: [h3]Hi everyone, it's time to share some news with you, the first news since I started reworking my game.[/h3][h3][/h3][p]First of all, I wanted to rework the very concept of the game, to make a simulation where the player himself builds a club as he wants and almost anywhere he wants. Mechanics went more towards strategy and management, but it will not make the game more stuffy, and I would say even on the contrary. I have plans to make a game where you can relax, and in this respect I think I hit the mark. To all the pluses I can add more variability and even more elements that the player can control. For example, optimizing the flow of visitors, expanding rooms, managing resources such as drink stocks, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]At the moment the construction system has been implemented. Now you can build a club as you want, any shape and any size (within the map). Partially realized the system of tasks for the staff. Further I plan to finish the construction system completely and will start to realize the visitors in the club.[/p][p][/p][p]And now I'm done, thanks for following the project and see you in the next diary![/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #6
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! In this diary I would like to share my progress since the release of the last diary. I am very pleased with the fact that I have been very productive. [/h3]

I have done a lot of work on optimizing the game and the project as a whole. I have redone several systems such as: building system, delivery system, improved online stores, improved NPC behavior system, and improved the ordering system.

I also want to note the improvements in feedback from the game, it became feel and play much better thanks to new animations and some assets.

At the moment I'm working on the quest system, which I made this week, and I'm also planning to start developing the story for the game.

This time I was surprised to see that there were no major difficulties and the process went very quickly. So I hope to publish the game in full access very soon.

[h3]Thanks for following the project![/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary #5
notes.content:
[h3]It's been a while since the last devlog was released, so today I'm sharing game development news again.[/h3]

First off, I'd like to start by noting the release date of the game.
I have plans to finish development by summer. At this point the game is almost ready, all that's left to do is finalize a few important mechanics and polish the game. I really want to publish the game already, but every time I have to postpone the release. I'm working on another project as a programmer and now I don't have enough time to develop my own game. But nevertheless I try to give time for my game as much as possible. 

To the slowing down of the pace of development I started restructuring my game. I started cleaning up code, scenes, unnecessary mechanics, prefabs and so on. When a project is a mess, it becomes very difficult to continue development. That's why I'm spending the last time on polishing the existing mechanics and restructuring the project.

Now about what I realized. I improved the system and the code of the NPS, namely improved the queue system, the logic of order selection and logic in general and optimized the code because before it was very much affected the performance. Made a new bar system. To pour drinks is not boring and in general was interesting I made a whole mini game, in the future I want to improve it a little more. Added a new location for the club, as well as the ability to choose the original location and type of club.

I won't add a lot of minor corrections and will focus on the most important points. So that's it, thanks for following the project!

notes.title: Dev Diary #4
notes.content:
Hi, welcome to the new developer diary.

Since the last issue, I've been focusing on improving the game's feel and balance. During this period, I've reworked a few key mechanics:

[list]
[*] Improved the bar and drink pouring system, making the process smoother and more intuitive.
[*] Revamped the DJ work, improving the music and interaction with the sound.
[*] Updated the dance floor mechanics and visitor behavior.
[/list]

However, in the process of making the changes, some bugs arose that I'm actively working on now. This required rewriting several standard engine scripts to ensure stability and improve performance.

Thank you for following the development of the game!
